name: Scientific Visualization / Data Storytelling
visualIdentity: Explains concepts through accurate, clearly labeled data, diagrams and mechanisms. Define variables, units, data and causal links before drawing; introduce ideas gradually with pauses. This is an explanatory format, with The Pudding and 3Blue1Brown cited as references, not a claim about their production tools.
suitableUses: Explicitly suited to science explainers, research summaries, charts, process mechanisms and verified network or geographic data. Inferred: a strong choice for video or interactive HTML when staged explanation and legible evidence matter.
limitations: Avoid misleading scales, invented values, unsupported causal claims and decorative motion that replaces explanation. Preserve labels and readable layouts. Rough contours must not distort measured geometry. Triangulation does not establish scientific interpolation or semantic relationships; map paths do not prove routes.
palette: Suggested fallback only when no task, brand, reference or semantic palette exists: background #FAF7EF, foreground #263744, accents #367E88, #C17E49, #856B9A. Preserve supplied colors and stable category meanings; use discrete tokens, no gradient. Suggested text pair has 11.455 contrast; accent pairings listed for text fall below 4.5. Check actual composited frames.
motionAndInteraction: Reveal objects, mechanisms, comparisons and conclusions in order, with reading holds. Use seekable, deterministic time for video. Interactive HTML may add bounded scroll storytelling, scale zoom with correct persistent units, chapter handoffs, or reversible exploded views only when supported by the subject. Preserve causal clarity and accessible keyboard, touch and reduced-motion behavior.
audio: No fixed soundtrack is specified. Choose music, narration, effects, ambience or silence for the topic and audience; honor supplied requirements and assets. Keep speech intelligible, avoid clipping and competing vocals, and synchronize audio with picture.
assetRequirements: Use verified data, units, scales, labels and causal relationships. Prepare diagrams or model outputs as needed; optional inputs include authored tldraw assets, 2D charts, graph data or GeoJSON with valid coordinates and attribution. State unverified assumptions; do not present simulation as validated physics.
combinations: Pairs well with style-109 diagram drawing for mechanisms and style-098 continuous scale zoom where scales are genuinely nested. Keep color meanings consistent and units visible. Avoid implying continuity where none exists. Use alone when labeled charts and mechanisms suffice.
productionApproach: Manim and NumPy are recommended for mathematical animation and verified calculations; SVG/D3 can support other charts. Optional tools cover diagram authoring, sketch marks, 2D meshes, graph/map data and procedural drawing. Select renderer and motion engine by scene needs. HyperFrames is primary for seekable composition and export; Remotion only if unavailable or a verified limitation blocks a required output. These pipelines do not own visual design. For HTML, map scroll or controls to accessible, reversible states.
